newsitem.title: UK: RUGBY UNION-O'LEARY NAMED AS ENGLAND'S 30TH PLAYER.
newsitem.headline: RUGBY UNION-O'LEARY NAMED AS ENGLAND'S 30TH PLAYER.

text.p: Harlequins' uncapped winger Daren O'Leary was named on Thursday as England's 30th player in the party to tour Argentina next month.
O'Leary, who has played once for England A, joins the 29 players called up last week by coach Jack Rowell for the two-test series against the Pumas.
When he announced the squad last Wednesday, Rowell said he was waiting on fitness tests to several players before filling the final place.
O'Leary is one of 15 uncapped players in an England squad weakened by the absence of 18 men who were required by the British Lions in South Africa.
